ancient_space_man: Arno Man arrived at P-F5 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
benryderfitz: "You're late," said the corporal when Otto Benryderfitz arrived on Day 10. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
broadshoulderedbastard: Hugo "Lucky" Broadshoulde came up the line with a photograph gone soft at the edges and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Hugo "Lucky" Broadshoulde began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.

A shell landed square in S-F20. They found Hugo "Lucky" Broadshoulde alive under the sandbags, barely. Every minute counts now. Hugo "Lucky" Broadshoulde died at his post at S-F20 when the dugout roof came down under a direct hit.

Rafael Broadshoulde came to the front because his uncle Hugo "Lucky" Broadshoulde never came home. He carries a photograph gone soft at the edges. Hill 304 has been won. Rafael Broadshoulde listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Rafael Broadshoulde checked every ammunition belt by lamplight. One bad cartridge was enough to make him start the whole inspection again.
On sentry duty Rafael Broadshoulde watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.

Rafael Broadshoulde had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Hugo Kitty was grazed. A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Rafael Broadshoulde across the shin at S-F20. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Isidor Jacksondeehr of the Concord (@jacksondeehring).
Rafael Broadshoulde is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Rafael Broadshoulde was hit hard in the fight at S-F20 before anyone could fire. The raider was Gideon Mirwik of the Concord. Raider: Gideon Mirwik of the Concord (@_mirwik_). Rafael Broadshoulde threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Severin Guy was down and screaming for a medic. (@hi.its.guy) The Concord raiders were in and out in two minutes. At S-F20 they left Rafael Broadshoulde behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Norbert Seamus of the Concord (@seamus_bj).
Quentin "Hollow" Broadshoulde put a photograph gone soft at the edges beside the bunk. Someone who had known Rafael Broadshoulde helped clear the shelf without saying why.
damocles4152: After 10 days of war, T-F2 had a place for everything. On Day 10, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Jakub Damocles.
ethanbay_23: Wendel "Parson" Ethanbay arrived with the evening ration party, carrying his mother's thimble and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

A shell landed square in S-S9. They found Wendel "Parson" Ethanbay alive under the sandbags, barely. Every minute counts now. Wendel "Parson" Ethanbay was killed outright by a direct hit at S-S9. The men dug for an hour and found only his identity disc.

The House of Ethanbay sent another. Hugo "Button" Ethanbay, older brother of Wendel "Parson" Ethanbay, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence. Day 6. The Hegemony took Hill 304. From the heights Hugo "Button" Ethanbay could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Shellfire stopped the carrying party at a trench junction. Hugo "Button" Ethanbay waited under a load that got heavier by the minute.
The promotion to Lance Corporal reached Hugo "Button" Ethanbay on a creased slip of paper. He smoothed it and put it with the letters from home.
Hugo "Button" Ethanbay was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Hugo "Button" Ethanbay's bunk. He has named it Margarethe.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-S9 changed before the cheering ended. Hugo "Button" Ethanbay shouldered another load.
josh.wamble: Bastian "Parson" Wamble unpacked a tin whistle at Q-F9. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
metropolitan_wr: They issued Clement Metropolitan a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a cracked shaving mirror in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Clement Metropolitan read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
moist_breadcrumb: Clement Breadcrumb, a schoolteacher from Greyhallow, was sent forward on Day 6 to fill a gap in R-S6. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Marek "Smokes" Mod and Clement Breadcrumb carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
Tobias Deadeyesimul (Hegemony) watched Clement Breadcrumb (Concord) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at the Drowned Farm, and held fire until both were gone.
Clement Breadcrumb spent the night underground, listening. Somewhere beneath Calvary Farm someone else was digging too.

Clement Breadcrumb went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits. From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Clement Breadcrumb wrote to an old father who runs the family shop alone that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
penigorouspen: Ivo Penigorouspe came up the line with a key to a house that is no longer there and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Ivo Penigorouspe stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
porsche930tt: Ulrich Porsche arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Ulrich Porsche wrote to five brothers, all on other fronts that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
summacon1: The draft reached S-R2 on Day 9. Otto Summacon was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Otto Summacon looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
the_knight_of_reikland: Jakub "Spark" Reikland, a stonemason from Dunmarrow, was sent forward on Day 10 to fill a gap in T-F21. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
zczc1317: Nils Zczc left a girl from the dance hall, maybe behind in Millbank and came up the line with a bullet that missed him. The men noticed at once that he never sits with his back to the parapet.
The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Nils Zczc was number 91. He still remembers how cold the colonel's glove was.
Day 3. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. From the heights Nils Zczc could see the whole Hegemony line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
A bullet went through Nils Zczc's sleeve at S-F9 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Cyril Mateorekon of the Hegemony (@mateorekon).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Nils Zczc is whole again, or near enough for the line.

Nils Zczc lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Nils Zczc kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Nils Zczc. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.
Edmund "Smokes" Rry taught Nils Zczc to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.
The cook borrowed Nils Zczc's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
Nils Zczc delivered an urgent message and waited while the officer searched every pocket for a pencil to sign for it.

At S-F9 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Nils Zczc turned around and took a shovel blow. Gideon Jimmysparrow of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Gideon Jimmysparrow of the Hegemony (@jimmysparrow17). After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Nils Zczc helped stack spare sandbags at S-F9. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
